column1: # DIMENSIONS.tsv — what the frozen listings CONTAIN, in the terms consumers ask in.
# PIN.tsv records the frozen artifacts' BYTES. This file records their SHAPE: for each structural
# dimension a consumer reads through `oracle_core::symbols`, the answer the frozen bytes actually give.
#   PIN.tsv        : "are our bytes the bytes we recorded?"   (gate: crates/oracle-replay/tests/aeon_pin.rs)
#   DIMENSIONS.tsv : "are our SHAPES the shapes we recorded?" (gate: crates/oracle-core/tests/aeon_dimensions.rs)
# Both ask the RECOVERY question, at the pinning revision, about this repository alone. Neither asks
# whether aeon has moved — that is the CURRENCY question and lives in the non-gating
# `tools/aeon_pin_report.py`, which reads aeon's object store at a ref.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS — the failure it makes visible
# A frozen listing drifts away from the build it was taken from, and the drift is exactly where new
# faults live. Four sightings, all re-measured here rather than taken on report:
#     `equates_with_prefix` at crates/oracle-aether/src/engine.rs:6813) works ENTIRELY by reading the
#     `ObjSub_Spring__` namespace. The frozen listings publish ZERO equates under `ObjSub_`; aeon's
#     build publishes eight. Every test of that picker is therefore synthetic, and nothing said so.
#     engine.rs:6702). Frozen `s4.debug.lst` declares five archetypes; aeon's declares six. The missing
#     one is `ObjDef_Spring` — the archetype the picker above is about.
#   * `Phase Table` — absent from every frozen listing; aeon's `s4*.lst` carry `PHASE-COUNT 6` and
#     `demo*.lst` carry `PHASE-COUNT 2`. A fault in phase parsing was invisible to the frozen path by
#   * the LIVE-EFFECTS PANEL (`oracle-player/src/effects.rs`) resolves twelve names and refuses to write
#     when the listing disagrees with the address its note recorded (`Channel::drift`). Against these
#     frozen listings that refusal fires on EVERY channel, for two different reasons at once:
#       - nine of the twelve are PRESENT AT A DIFFERENT ADDRESS. The parallax block is a uniform `-4`
#         against the note (`Parallax_Current_Config` is `$FFFF88E8` here, `$FFFF88EC` there); the raster
#         block is `-0x10E`; `BgAnim_LastStep` is `-0x128`. Presence alone reports full coverage of a
#         panel that, on these bytes, refuses every gesture it offers — which is why `symbol_addr` exists
#       - three are ABSENT outright: `BgAnim_Table_Ptr` (the bands channel's whole selector — absent from
#         `s4.debug.lst` TOO, so the frozen DEBUG listing also predates it), `BgAnim_Table_Empty` (the
#         bands-off target) and `Debug_Lab_Index` (the cursor `forbidden` refuses writes to). The bands
#         channel therefore cannot be exercised at all on the frozen path, and `forbidden`'s second
#     ⚑ `$FFFF8BD6` — where the note puts `Raster_Program` — IS a symbol in these listings: it is
#     `Raster_Active_Buf`. So this drift is a restructure of `Raster_State`, not a slide, and a probe that
#     resolved by address rather than by name would have found a plausible wrong answer.
#     ⚑ `EditorRaster_` is NOT empty here, contrary to the report that opened this row: `s4.lst` and
#     `s4.debug.lst` each carry one, `EditorRaster_OJZ_Act1_authored_probe`. What is absent is the
#     `..._ramp_probe` that `effects.rs`'s own `Fake::full()` invents. The demo listings carry none.
#     present in aeon's build at `$FFFFEA70`/`$FFFFEA72`. This is the pair from the field sighting behind
#     `F-RELOAD-KEEPS-STALE-SYMBOLS`: a session trusted `symbolsDropped: false`, then got
#     `no symbol named or prefixed Level_Width` for a symbol sitting in the listing on disk. All of that
#     defect's coverage is synthetic, and this row is why.
# Not every probe here is a namespace: `symbol_present` covers a dimension that is one specific NAME. A
# manifest that could only count prefixes would have missed the sighting above entirely.
# A row recording `0` or `absent` is NOT a defect and NOT a reason to move the pin. It is a recorded
# blind spot, and `relied_on_by` names who is running blind. The gate prints those rows every run.
# ⚑ A `0` here is only meaningful because the probe that produced it is proven able to return non-zero:
#    `aeon_dimensions.rs` runs a POSITIVE CONTROL for every probe kind against a synthetic listing that
#    does carry the dimension. Without that, a dead probe and an absent dimension are the same artifact.
#   file          the frozen listing in this directory
#   probe         how the dimension is measured, THROUGH THE PARSER CONSUMERS USE (never a re-grep):
#   arg           the probe's argument, or `-` when it takes none
#   frozen        the answer the frozen bytes give: an integer, a `$HEX` address, or `absent`
#                 ⚑ `symbol_addr` STRICTLY SUBSUMES `symbol_present` — an absent name is `absent` rather
#                 than `0` — and it is the RAW 32-bit spelling the listing itself writes (`$FFFF88E8`,
#                 never the 24-bit door form `$FF88E8`), because that is the spelling every consumer
#                 holding a transcribed address compares against; `effects.rs`'s `Channel::drift` is
#                 explicit that comparing the 24-bit form would make every channel read as drifted.
#                 An address row MUST be written `$HEX`; `read_manifest` refuses a decimal one, because a
#                 decimal address would measure correctly, print back in hex, and never be noticed.
#                 ⚑ AN `absent` HERE IS AN EXPECTED VALUE, NOT A HOLE. A name BECOMING PRESENT reddens
#                 this gate exactly as a name vanishing does. A row that could only notice presence would
#   upstream      aeon path (tracked, so it is readable from the object store at a ref) that publishes
#                 this dimension, or `-` when it has no single tracked origin — which here also covers
#                 `Debug_Lab_Index`, whose origin this lane has not verified against aeon's tree
#   relied_on_by  who reads this dimension. For an absent row, this names who runs blind.
